scope: Post-inference qualitative diagnosis only. No labels, model settings or predictions changed. Not an independent human review.
finding: The sampled frames around these resets show continuous close-view play with the blue player numbered 96, not separate scenes. The repeated resets are undesirable. Fine patterned flooring and camera motion are possible triggers; their individual contributions were not measured.
consequence: The frozen linker rejects candidates whose endpoints have different scene labels. Seven known same-person reference pairs cross this boundary. Some could also fail for other reasons, so this is not an isolated estimate of recoverable accuracy.
